title: Whole Grain Pasta with Tomato Sauce and Meat, Ready-to-Heat

content.title: About
content.content: Whole grain pasta with tomato sauce and meat pieces is a ready‑to‑heat meal that can be quickly warmed in a microwave or on the stove. It contains whole‑grain pasta, a tomato‑based sauce, tender meat (usually beef or pork), and a blend of spices. Designed for a convenient, nutritious lunch or dinner.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whole grain pasta provides more fiber and micronutrients than traditional white‑flour pasta.
The tomato sauce is rich in lycopene, a powerful antioxidant that supports heart health.
Meat adds a complete set of essential amino acids.
The dish is formulated for fast preparation: only 2–3 minutes in the microwave are needed.
Herbs such as basil and oregano are often included, enhancing flavor without extra salt.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Whole grain pasta supplies dietary fiber, promoting healthy digestion and satiety.

items.title: Good source of protein
items.content: The meat component provides high‑quality protein essential for tissue repair and muscle maintenance.

items.title: Lycopene and antioxidants
items.content: Tomatoes deliver lycopene, which helps protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The meal contains B1, B3, and B6 vitamins that support energy metabolism.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: Iron, zinc, and magnesium are present, contributing to immune function and nerve health.

items.title: Gluten sensitivity
items.content: Whole grain pasta contains gluten, making the product unsuitable for people with celiac disease or gluten intolerance.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: The tomato sauce can be salty; individuals monitoring sodium intake should consider the total daily amount.

items.title: Meat fat
items.content: Depending on the meat type, the dish may contain saturated fats; moderation is advised.

items.title: Heat hotspots
items.content: Microwave heating may create hot spots; stir the meal before serving to ensure even temperature.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the portion in the microwave (about 2–3 minutes) or on the stovetop, stir, let it cool slightly, and serve. Optional additions include fresh herbs, grated cheese, or a drizzle of olive oil for extra flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened package in a cool, dry place. Once opened, keep the product refrigerated and consume within 3–4 days. Discard if you notice off‑odors or discoloration.
